meta.label_method: Gold labels human-verified by reading each review TEXT. When review text and star rating conflicted, the TEXT was treated as ground truth (the test set evaluates how systems read text, not how users click stars). Aspect labels left as previously seeded.
meta.stratification: by detected_language (PH languages oversampled); rating-spread within language

samples.text:
一言で言って、味は日本のファミリーレストラン並み、サービスはそれより遥かに下です。一品ずつのボリュームは多いですが出来損ないのアメリカ料理のようです。ほとんどの料理が事前に作られたものを温め直しただけのもので、ちょっと気の利いた飛行機の機内食のような内容でした。ナチョスが人気だということで半分以上のグループが頑んでいましたが、確かに熱いチーズを卓上でかけてくれる演出は多少興味深いものの、（単純に量が多いからか不味いからかは不明ですが）皆さん食べきらずに8割以上の人たちが持ち帰っていました。
特筆すべきはサービスの悪さで、ビールの追加の際にも、3人くらいに頑んでやっと出てくる有様でした。おまけに3回目に頑んだ際には、こちらを指差して「あの客は何度も頑んでしつこい」という態度で非常に腹が立ちました。わかっているんならさっさと持って来いと思いました。
とにかく絶対に避けたほうがいい店です。

Nanawag ko 4 times para mag reserve pero dili gyud sila ga tubag. So no choice, nag walk in nalang mi.
Pagka kuha namog table, wala man lang mi gi hatagan ug menu para maka pili. So after 15 mins, gi tawag namo uban nila staff para sa menu kay ga hulata rasad mi. Take note, nag bayad mog 5% sa service nila.
Dapat silay mag dala sa customer, kay gi bayaran sila ana. So naka order nami.
After na serve ang Nachos ug soda, 30 mins aya gi serve ang spaghetti. Excited pakay mi sa mga upcoming nga gi hulat namo nga orders. Ang steak ug baby back.
After 1 hour, sa sigeg pa remind aya pa gi serve ang steak namo. Pero wala nay gana kay perting dugaya gyud.
1 hour and 30 mins na nilabay, gi remind nasad namo among order na baby back, pero grabe bay wala padaw gi luto. Amo nalang gi cancel ang baby back total wala paman daw gi luto. Duda namo ang nag kuha sa among order nabulabog. Perti ka ngil ad gyud among na experience ay. Ga celebrate pa raba unta mig anniversary. First and last nato namo. Daghan good reviews bay. Pero sa price nga gina bayaran, mahal kaayo siya then poor kaayo ang service, ga bayad pa naman 5% unya ing ana among ma experience. Dili gyud siya worth it. Summary:
*DISGUSTING FOOD - There's a fly on our food
*Unprofessional Staffs

1. Babyback ribs - As you can see on the photos, there is a fly (langaw) on our food! Kadiri! Kinuha lang nila basta and pinalitan nung sinabi namin.

No apology or anything from them, kahit yung mismong manager (owner?) na babae, dedma lang kahit ininform namin siya about this. Ang bastos lang.

2. Angus beef - The beef itself was just meh. However, just look at that "mashed potato". I specifically asked their server kung powder or real potato ba yung mashed potato nila, sabi niya tunay daw. Pati ata yun hindi nila alam. Tingnan niyo naman itsura oh. Mukhang muffin dahil powder na nga, hindi pa niluto nang maayos.

3. General comment - Their food are obviously pre-made then reheated. Meron ka makakain minsan na malamig pa na parts. Some resto rin naman ginagawa to pero sakanila di magawa nang maayos at sobrang halata. Yuck!

4. Incompetent din yung servers nila. Yung lalaking kumuha ng order namin, hindi nalista lahat tapos sinisi pa kami nung kulang. Ang labo kausap. Hinayaan nalang namin.

For the price, you would expect an above average experience, pero kabaliktaran pala. Sobrang walang kwenta dito, promise. If you're looking to impress someone or have a nice dinner, I would highly suggest you look elsewhere because you will not get it from here.

If di pa enough to for you to avoid them, just check out the reviews from other people. 🙃

samples.text:
Food is good, no question. My personal favorites are Wagyu Skewers, Firecracker Maki Roll, and Miso soup. Staff were friendly too. My only disappointment are as follows:

1. We requested our orders to be served at the same time. We were told yes but the foods were still served one at a time. Sana hindi na lang kami in-oo ng crew.

2. Miso soup was served already cold. We requested this to be served with the other orders and to serve it still hot. Again, crew said yes only to serve the Miso separately later on AND no longer hot. Super disappointing for me since I keep coming back to The Pantry for their hot Miso soup;

3. The crew, more than once, asked for our plates even though we have not yet finished eating. The first instance I told them we were not yet finished as there’s still food on our table but the staff still came back, interrupting our talks, asking for the plates. I found this really rude.

‘wouldve given 5-star rating were it not for the above unpleasant experience. (Note: at least 3 different crews served us.) Hope they’ll improve on these.
It could be better. Prices could be better, too.
samples.verify_note: 'It could be better. Prices could be better, too.' expresses mild dissatisfaction, not praise.
